name: J11
note: Beauty-only look (scripts/aircraft_look.py). Every class parameter not stated here is the master default; every look number here is UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine. Semi-matte PLAAF grey. Round 2 (cockpit-airframe, 2026-11-09): Roughness 0.58 -> 0.46, ClearCoat 0.12 -> 0.3, ClearCoatRoughness 0.3 -> 0.2, because the render machine's Gate V specular clause found NO interior airframe pixel above luma 180 on shots b, c and d (peak/median 4.5-18 but the peak never reached the cut): a sun glint needs both the smooth crease normals of body_beauty (the facets scattered it) and a narrower lobe than 0.58; still a painted fighter, not a gloss airliner. UNCALIBRATED.j11-package lane (2026-11-09): the slot names are now measured on the converted J-11A (25 MTL slots: assets_pipeline/convert.py over the pinned package, docs/visual/J11_PACKAGE.md); the cockpit interior, seat and pilot slots are matte (the rubber master: Default Lit, no clear coat, no panel lines) with a roughness derived from the package's own .ac shininess (fg_material); the canopy and the pilot's visor are glass. Lamps and nozzles sit at the package's own model-XML positions (package_model_m), mapped to the actor frame the way the converter maps every vertex. Fix pass (2026-11-09): light_constants.BulbRadiusCm 6 -- the default 18 cm glow sprite and point-light source radius is an airliner's wingtip lens and glare, about three times a fighter's wingtip nav lens; the bulb's luminance follows its candela over that area (scripts/aircraft_look.py bulb_luminance_nits), so a smaller bulb is brighter, not dimmer. UNCALIBRATED.

Models/Interior/pilot/pilot.xml: transp.png is the visor (lunettes) of the pilot figure, drawn transparent by the package

measured 2026-11-09 from the converter's material_sources.json: every triangle of these slots comes from Models/Interior/panel.ac, seat2.ac or pilot/fighter_default.ac (instrument panel, K-36DM seat, pilot figure): fabric, cushions and matt cockpit paint, not clear-coated airframe skin

fg_material.source: j11-package lane: the interior .ac materials carry varied Phong exponents (seat2.ac shi 0 / 5 / 10 / 12 / 20 / 64 / 88 / 128, panel.ac 64, pilot 64), so the roughness is the package's own; airframe paint is NOT derived (every Su-27.ac painted material is shi 128 spec 1, an authoring habit that would make matte PLAAF grey glossy, roughness 0.35); the floor 0.5 keeps Su-27.ac's black shi-128 rubber (rgb_000000) from reading as gloss. UNCALIBRATED as a look
